name: Barrel Hunter's Challenge

start.dialog: Hey there! Heard about the barrel tradition here - crazy, right? But fun! I'm looking for the LEGENDARY barrel. Solid iron. Said to be hidden in the Dustbelt somewhere. Help me find it?
start.objective: Search the Dustbelt for the legendary iron barrel

progress.dialog: No luck yet? Keep looking! It's gotta be around here somewhere!
progress.objective: Continue searching for the iron barrel in hidden areas

complete.dialog: You FOUND it! Look at this thing! SOLID iron! Okay, here goes... HA! Kicked it clean in half! Thanks for the help! Take these - premium leather gloves. Good for punching things!

party_comments.kade: She kicked an IRON barrel in half? That's... impressive.
party_comments.twist: TEACH ME! I want to kick barrels too!

hidden_outcome: If you kick the barrel before Tifa does, she challenges you to a friendly sparring match and teaches 'Somersault Kick'
